### Deploy

This snippet creates the model, endpoint configuration, and endpoint with the recipe settings. Outside SageMaker Studio, replace `get_execution_role()` with the role lookup from [Set up the SDK](../tutorials/sagemaker-sdk/setup-sagemaker-sdk#execution-role). To send requests, see [Invoke the endpoint](./deploy-a-recipe#invoke-the-endpoint).

```python
import os
import boto3
from sagemaker.core.helper.session_helper import Session, get_execution_role

# AWS region where the endpoint runs
region = "us-east-1"
name = "llama-3-1-8b-instruct-g6e-2xlarge"

# set up the SageMaker session and execution role
sess = Session(boto_session=boto3.Session(region_name=region))
role = get_execution_role()
sm = sess.boto_session.client("sagemaker")

image = f"763104351884.dkr.ecr.{region}.amazonaws.com/huggingface-vllm@sha256:ab85af8f64c47ddb9ba40ddb94727f4e9563743fd763d2934c110191568cfe39"
environment = {
    "SM_VLLM_ENABLE_AUTO_TOOL_CHOICE": "true",
    "SM_VLLM_MAX_MODEL_LEN": "32768",
    "SM_VLLM_MODEL": "meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct",
    "SM_VLLM_REVISION": "0e9e39f249a16976918f6564b8830bc894c89659",
    "SM_VLLM_SERVED_MODEL_NAME": "meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct",
    "SM_VLLM_TENSOR_PARALLEL_SIZE": "1",
    "SM_VLLM_TOOL_CALL_PARSER": "llama3_json"
}
# gated models need a Hugging Face token: read it from your environment
if "HF_TOKEN" in os.environ:
    environment["HF_TOKEN"] = os.environ["HF_TOKEN"]

sm.create_model(
    ModelName=name,
    # IAM role with permissions to create an endpoint
    ExecutionRoleArn=role,
    PrimaryContainer={"Image": image, "Environment": environment},
)
sm.create_endpoint_config(
    EndpointConfigName=name,
    ProductionVariants=[
        {
            "VariantName": "AllTraffic",
            "ModelName": name,
            "InstanceType": "ml.g6e.2xlarge",
            "InitialInstanceCount": 1,
            "InferenceAmiVersion": "al2023-ami-sagemaker-inference-gpu-4-1",
            "ContainerStartupHealthCheckTimeoutInSeconds": 3600,
        }
    ],
)
sm.create_endpoint(EndpointName=name, EndpointConfigName=name)

# wait up to 90 minutes for the endpoint to reach InService
sm.get_waiter("endpoint_in_service").wait(
    EndpointName=name, WaiterConfig={"Delay": 60, "MaxAttempts": 90}
)
print(f"{name} is InService")
```

### Clean up

Delete the endpoint, endpoint configuration, and model to stop billing:

```python
import boto3

# AWS region where the endpoint runs
region = "us-east-1"
name = "llama-3-1-8b-instruct-g6e-2xlarge"

sm = boto3.client("sagemaker", region_name=region)
sm.delete_endpoint(EndpointName=name)
sm.delete_endpoint_config(EndpointConfigName=name)
sm.delete_model(ModelName=name)
```
